scope: workspace media content/metadata publication, not plugin installation or an atomic SQLite/filesystem transaction
checks: Real WAV upload journals content and metadata separately under the response request/actor; bytes and metadata SHA-256 agree; identical reupload is a no-op
Real FFprobe metadata repair records before/after identity and CLI provenance; independent PCM decoding proves content preservation
Prepare-record insertion failure rolls back both journal tables and prevents content publication
Completion-record failure returns explicit unknown outcome after real rename; locked reconciliation records observed_applied with original and recovery request IDs and is repeatable
Changed on-disk metadata is recorded as observed_diverged without fabricating success or overwriting evidence; explicit repair uses the current fingerprint
Corrupted existing content cannot be silently reused or replaced by a same-hash upload; failed verification leaves both bytes and journal unchanged
Separate decimal cursor pages every transition exactly once; invalid paths and restricted project audit credentials reject; standalone reopen preserves all events
media_repair_contract: inspect returns metadata_hash; repair re-probes verified content bytes and atomically replaces only if expected_metadata_hash still matches; source media bytes and project revisions remain unchanged
